title: scan_col skips the x-coordinate bounds check before indexing the pixel buffer — latent out-of-bounds read
detail: New scanner validates only yi; cx is indexed unguarded. If fixture camera math drifts off-screen (the premise pins acknowledge this), the read runs past the buffer — a panic instead of the intended clean 0-px count.
recommended_fix: In scan_col, validate the x index before access — hoist `if cx < 0 || cx >= int(img.width) { return 0 }` above the loop (parity with scan_box/scan_dot).
